name: path-order-validation
rule: OHLC alone cannot determine whether +5% or -5% occurred first when both thresholds were touched. Such cases are ORDER_UNVERIFIED until timestamped intraday bars establish sequence.

DLXY.reason: Both -5% and +5% thresholds were crossed; daily OHLC does not establish which came first.

GLND.reason: Session low never reached -5% from entry while high exceeded +10%, so ordering ambiguity cannot change the result.

FLNA.reason: Both adverse -5% and favorable +10% thresholds occurred within the session; intraday ordering required.
